Looking for a gift with real meaning? This personalised name word art print turns a big blue letter G into a keepsake made entirely from their name and the words you choose. It's a thoughtful christening gift and a cheerful nursery print in one.

How your personalised name word art print comes together

Type their name in the first box; it appears once, in pride of place. In the second box, type 20 to 30 words separated by commas: hobbies, nicknames, family names, favourite places. We repeat them in different sizes, fonts and shades to fill the letter G. The preview shows your details before you add it to your basket.

Keep to single words or short phrases (three words at most), separated by commas, and leave out emoji, icons and accented letters. We print exactly what you type, so read it through once more.

Why you'll love it

  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1
  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand
  • One of a kind: every word comes from you, so no two prints are the same

Size & details

  • Design: a big blue letter G filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised name word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.

Whether it's for a birthday, a christening, a new home or Christmas morning, this is a gift they'll keep.
